facets.description: Lines 9-11: execute(...)[0]['id'] on the embed_category query has no zero-row check, so NoMethodError aborts db:migrate and the category_id == 0 fallback can never run
Line 15: the uncategorized_category_id lookup has the same unguarded [0]['value'] read
Lines 9-11: the JOIN compares the stored setting value to c.name, but the setting may hold a category id, so it never matches
